sentences.text: Scandal is an American rock band from the 1980s fronted by Patty Smyth .	Patty Smyth	Patty Smyth	rock	Rock music
The band scored a hit in the United States with the song `` The Warrior '' , which peaked at No. 7 in 1984 .	The Warrior	The Warrior (song)
